Small | ⭐ Review
💡 This review uniquely consolidates anion engineering strategies for sulfide solid electrolytes, linking anionic sublattice design to ionic transport, stability, and interfacial behavior. Small | 🔬 Research Article
💡 FeCe dual-atom catalyst co-anchored on hollow carbon fibers breaks the activity-stability trade-off in zinc-air batteries. Ce sites scavenge ROS and decompose H₂O₂ while modulating Fe centers, boosting ORR activity and preventing carbon degradation. It delivers 2300 cycles (~1100 h) of stable operation, offering a new pathway for ultra-durable zinc-air batteries.

Advanced Science | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 This work establishes oxygen partial pressure as a quantitative kinetic descriptor governing densification versus grain-growth competition in mid-nickel layered cathodes. This offers a scalable, predictive route for durable single-crystal cathode synthesis.

Nature Communications | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 This work achieves time-resolved 3D imaging of lithium metal growth inside working cells using in situ X-ray nano-tomography at sub-micron resolution. It identifies distinct needle-like and sheet-like growth modes, with elongation at tips, bases, kinks, or edges and minimal coarsening. Linking these modes to grain nucleation and SEI evolution provides unprecedented mechanistic insight into Li deposition, advancing high-energy Li-metal battery development.
